en.name: Stinky tofu, raw
en.summary: Raw brine-fermented stinky tofu keeps 2–3 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and 1–2 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Those figures are borrowed from tofu and deliberately shortened, because the brine ferment starts from a much higher microbial load than plain tofu does.
en.pantry: Not a shelf-stable preserved food, whatever the smell suggests. Raw stinky tofu is a fresh, high-moisture, low-acid soy product that has already been through an uncontrolled brine ferment — it starts its refrigerated life with far more microbial activity in it than an ordinary block of tofu, which is why the window here is short. It must be held at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and cooked through. Anything left out is in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) and follows the two-hour rule, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: 2–3 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in a sealed box — sealed as much for your other food as for the tofu, because the smell transfers to everything around it. Judge it by sourness and slime rather than by smell, which is the hard part: the fermented aroma is supposed to be strong, so the signal to watch for is a sour, sharply off note layered on top of it, and a slimy surface. Deep-fried stinky tofu is a cooked leftover and follows the leftover timeline of 3 to 4 days refrigerated instead of this one.
en.freezer: 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F), freezing the raw pieces individually on a tray before bagging so they do not fuse. The texture turns spongy on thawing, as the ice crystals rupture the curd and the water drains away — that suits deep-frying and braising very well, because a spongy block crisps harder and soaks up more sauce. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well beyond the window; what runs out is texture and the balance of the ferment.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter, and cook it through — raw stinky tofu is never eaten raw. Pieces thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; anything thawed warm must not be.
spoilage: A sour, sharp note layered on top of the normal fermented smell.
A slimy or ropy surface, or cloudy stringy brine.
Pink, orange or fuzzy growth on the surface, as opposed to the normal colour.
A block that has gone soft and lost its shape.
tips: Keep it double-boxed; the smell travels through a single container.
Freeze the pieces separately on a tray before bagging.
Cook it right through — this is not a food to eat underdone.
Frozen and thawed blocks fry crisper, which is a real advantage rather than a compromise.

faq.q: How long does raw stinky tofu keep?
faq.a: 2–3 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. The figure is borrowed from tofu and shortened, because the ferment starts from a much higher microbial load.
Yes, 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). The texture turns spongy, which actually suits deep-frying and braising.

faq.q: How do you tell if stinky tofu has gone bad when it already smells?
faq.a: Look and touch rather than sniff. A slimy or ropy surface, cloudy stringy brine, or a block that has lost its shape means it goes out.

zh.name: 生臭豆腐
zh.summary: 生的鹵水臭豆腐放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 2～3 天，−18 °C 冷凍是 1～2 個月。這些數字是從豆腐借來、而且刻意縮短的，因為鹵水發酵的起點本來就帶著比一般豆腐高得多的菌量。
zh.pantry: 不管聞起來多有個性，它都不是常溫的保存食品。生臭豆腐是含水量高、低酸的新鮮黃豆製品，而且已經經過一段不受控的鹵水發酵——它進冰箱的那一刻，身上的微生物活性就遠高於一塊普通豆腐，這也是這裡期限這麼短的原因。它必須維持在 4 °C 以下，而且要煮熟透。擺在外面的就在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶裡，適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 裝密封盒放 4 °C 以下 2～3 天——密封與其說是為了豆腐，不如說是為了冰箱裡其他東西，因為那個味道會沾到旁邊所有食物。判斷它壞沒壞要靠酸味和黏滑，而不是靠臭，這才是難的地方：發酵的臭本來就該很強，所以要注意的是疊在那股臭之上的「酸而刺鼻的異味」，以及表面發黏。炸好的臭豆腐屬於剩菜，冷藏可放 3～4 天，適用的是剩菜的期限而不是這一條。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 1～2 個月；生的先在盤子上單塊凍硬再裝袋，才不會黏成一坨。解凍後質地會變成海綿狀，因為冰晶撐破了凝乳、水分流掉了——那非常適合油炸和紅燒，因為海綿狀的豆腐炸得更酥、也更會吸醬汁。只要全程沒退冰，超過這段時間仍然安全；先用完的是口感和發酵的平衡。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，絕對不要放檯面，而且一定要煮熟透——生臭豆腐從來不是生吃的。在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；回溫過的絕對不行。
spoilage: 在正常的發酵臭之上，多了一股酸而刺鼻的異味。
表面黏滑、可以牽絲，或鹵水變濁牽絲。
表面長出粉紅、橘色或絨毛狀的菌落，而不是原本的顏色。
tips: 套兩層盒子；單層容器擋不住那個味道。
先在盤子上單塊凍硬再裝袋冷凍。
一定要煮熟透——這不是可以半生吃的東西。
冷凍解凍過的炸起來更酥，那是真正的優點，不是將就。

faq.a: 4 °C 以下冷藏 2～3 天。這個數字是從豆腐借來並縮短的，因為它的發酵起點菌量高得多。
可以，−18 °C 下 1～2 個月。解凍後會變海綿狀，而那其實很適合油炸和紅燒。

faq.q: 本來就這麼臭，要怎麼判斷它壞了？
faq.a: 用看的和摸的，不要用聞的。表面黏滑牽絲、鹵水變濁牽絲，或整塊失去形狀，就該丟掉。
